about.en: DOWGE (ticker DJI6930) is a dog-themed meme token on Solana, launched through pump.fun at mint DQnkBM4eYYMnVE8Qy2K3BB7uts1fh2EwBVktEz6jpump, that parodies the Dow Jones Industrial Average. It has no issuer backing or link to the index or to any stock; it is unrelated to the separate DOWGE token on Ethereum.
